subject: help building R package help files

messages.author: 4a15de51da4445ae
messages.subject: help building R package help files
parts:
hi all,
 ok this is off-topic but this is driving me nuts.... I'm trying to make an R help file for a function I made and the help file has a matrix multiplication in it like this:

x <- t(chol(V))%*%rnorm(900)

when the help file is compiled in the package the %*%rnorm(900) bit is cut off (doesn't appear in the help file). Thus, when you execute the example, you get gibberish.

Does someone know how to resolve this?

thanks!
andy

messages.author: 42d18e1dcfa62d26
messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] help building R package help files
parts:
Andy,
Since % is the universal LaTex character for comment (like # in R), I suspect that might be the issue. Try inserting a \ before each % and see if that helps.

Nick
